definitions.action: current cap bits; dominant three-bit packet integer; boundary packet exceptions tagged L0/L1/R0..R3
definitions.affine_deltas: integer coefficient * packet_length + constant, fitted and checked only on observations of the same source/action/target
definitions.control: finite size regime (small/base17/base20/stable); row phase and semantic cap mode; previous cap bits; left-face role; dominant BoundaryDefectAtom; boundary exceptions tagged L0/L1/R0..R3
definitions.determinism: each observed normalized source-control/action pair has one target control

limitations: The census contains generated affine traces only for n=17..119.
The n=11 and n=14 controls are single fixed equality traces, not complete equality languages.
A quiet observed horizon is not an induction or an arbitrary-k finite-control proof.
Singleton affine fits use coefficient zero and have no cross-width slope evidence.
